emergencyReadyBody: We'll alert the members of your family, with your location if you share it. Nexo Familia doesn't contact emergency services.
emergencyHoldHint: {seconds, plural, =1{Press and hold for 1 second} other{Press and hold for {seconds} seconds}}
emergencyLocationIncluded: Your location will be included if your phone gets it in time.
emergencyLocationApproxIncluded: Your approximate location (±1 km) will be included if your phone gets it in time.
emergencyLocationNotShared: You don't share your location with this family: the alert will go without it.
emergencyCallFailed: We couldn't open the dialer. Dial this number from your phone:
emergencyOfflineBanner: You're offline. If you send an alert, it will be saved on your phone and sent as soon as there's a connection.
emergencyNoFamily: To send alerts to your family, first create a family or join one.
emergencyCancelledNotice: You cancelled the alert. Nothing was sent.
emergencyDiscardedNotice: You cancelled sending. We've stopped trying; if it was already registered, it will show up here so you can end it.
emergencyCountdownTitle: The alert will be sent in
emergencyCountdownAnnouncement: {seconds, plural, =1{The alert will be sent in 1 second} other{The alert will be sent in {seconds} seconds}}
emergencyCountdownHint: Was it a mistake? Cancel before the countdown ends.
emergencyNotSavedBody: Try again. If it's urgent, call emergency services.
emergencyStepQueued: Saved on your phone. It will be sent as soon as there's a connection.
emergencyStepNotifyUnknown: Notice to your family's phones: not confirmed yet.
emergencyStepNotified: {count, plural, =1{Notice sent to 1 device} other{Notice sent to {count} devices}}
emergencyStepNotifiedNote: Sent doesn't mean anyone has seen it.
emergencyStepNobodyNotified: Nobody could be notified. Call {number} if you need to.
emergencyStepWaitingAck: Nobody has confirmed seeing it yet.
emergencyResolveBody: Your family will see that you ended it. Only do this if you no longer need help.
emergencyDiscardBody: We don't have confirmation that the alert was sent yet. If you cancel, we'll stop trying.
emergencyErrorNotMember: You're no longer a member of this family.
emergencyErrorNotSaved: We couldn't save the alert on your phone.
emergencyErrorSending: The alert is being sent right now. Wait a moment and try again.
emergencyErrorCannotAckOwn: You can't confirm your own alert.
emergencyErrorNotAuthor: Only the person who sent the alert can end it.
emergencyErrorNotFound: This alert is no longer available.
